varieties.name: Hass
varieties.supplier_notes: Export gold standard; 80% of Kenyan avocado exports. First fruit at 2-3 years; full yield at 5-7.

varieties.name: Fuerte
varieties.supplier_notes: Local market preferred; thinner skin; ships less well.

timeline_template.description_en: Mark planting holes 8m x 8m. Dig 60cm cubed holes. Mix topsoil + 2 tins manure per hole.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka alama mashimo 8m x 8m. Chimba mashimo 60cm pande zote. Changanya udongo na samadi.

timeline_template.description_en: Plant grafted seedling at original nursery depth. Stake against wind.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda mche uliotokana na kupandikiza, kina sawa na kitalu. Simika nguzo.

timeline_template.description_en: Apply 100g DAP per hole, mixed into soil before planting.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka gramu 100 za DAP kwa shimo.

timeline_template.description_en: Water 20L per tree weekly for first 12 weeks if no rain.
timeline_template.description_sw: Mwagilia lita 20 kwa mti kwa wiki kwa wiki 12 ikiwa hakuna mvua.

timeline_template.description_en: Intercrop the avenues with beans, sukuma, dhania or butternut — the annuals pay the land rent while the orchard matures.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda maharagwe, sukuma, dhania au butternut katikati — mazao ya msimu yanalipa kodi ya ardhi wakati miti inakua.

timeline_template.description_en: Hand-weed basin around tree. Mulch heavily.
timeline_template.description_sw: Palia kuzunguka mti. Funika na nyasi.

timeline_template.description_en: Apply 250g NPK 17:17:17 per tree. Split into 2 doses 6 months apart.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka gramu 250 za NPK kwa mti. Gawanya dosi 2.

timeline_template.description_en: Light pruning to shape — remove suckers and crossing branches.
Scout for false codling moth + thrips. Spray only at threshold.
timeline_template.description_sw: Tafuta vidudu vya parachichi. Nyunyuza wakizidi.

timeline_template.description_en: First commercial fruits at year 2-3. Pick when fruit is firm and dark.
timeline_template.description_sw: Matunda ya kwanza ya kuuza mwaka 2-3. Vuna yakiwa magumu.
timeline_template.tip_en: Hass: skin turns dark before pick. Fuerte: skin stays green; test by feel.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Hass: ngozi inakuwa nyeusi. Fuerte: ngozi inabaki kijani.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Export A: 200-350g, no blemishes, oil content 23%+. Grade B: 150-200g or minor scars.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: Cold chain 4-7°C from pack-house to destination. Don't freeze.

diseases.symptoms_en: Larvae tunnel into fruit; the #1 export quarantine pest on Kenyan avocados.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Viluwiluwi hutoboa matunda; mdudu namba moja wa kukataliwa kwa kuuza nje.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered larvicides on orchard schedule; remove and destroy fallen fruit. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa zilizoidhinishwa kwa ratiba; ondoa na uteketeze matunda yaliyoanguka. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Orchard sanitation, monitoring traps, harvest on time.
diseases.prevention_sw: Usafi wa shamba, mitego ya kuchunguza, vuna kwa wakati.
diseases.scanner_notes: Fruit close-up at the sting point.

diseases.symptoms_en: Black sunken spots on fruit, often appearing days after picking, pink ooze in humidity.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa meusi yaliyozama, yanaonekana siku chache baada ya kuvuna, ute wa pinki unyevu.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered anthracnose-active sprays pre-harvest; clean dry handling. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya kuvuna; shika pakavu na safi. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Prune for airflow, harvest dry, handle gently.
diseases.prevention_sw: Kata matawi kwa hewa, vuna pakavu, shika kwa upole.
diseases.scanner_notes: Fruit close-up; post-harvest timing of spots is diagnostic.

diseases.symptoms_en: Yellowing leaves, branch dieback, sparse canopy, dark lesions at the collar, wet soil.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Majani kuwitikia, matawi kufa, kichwa cheusi cha miti, udongo wenye maji.
diseases.treatment_en: None once advanced — improve drainage, remove dying trees. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba ikiwa imeendelea — boresha mifereji, ng'oa miti inayokufa. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Certified clean seedlings, perfect drainage, no collar watering.
diseases.prevention_sw: Miche safi iliyothibitishwa, mifereji bora, usimwagilie kwenye shina.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph the tree base + canopy; ask about water pooling in-app.

diseases.symptoms_en: Silver-bronze fruit scarring (thrips), dark sooty mould on leaves (scales).
diseases.symptoms_sw: Matunda yenye makovu ya fedha (vidukari), ukungu mweusi majani (magamba).
diseases.treatment_en: Registered products at threshold only. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa zilizoidhinishwa tu wakati wamezidi. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.scanner_notes: Fruit surface photo for thrips; leaf underside for scales.

diseases.severity_classes: Low (scattered spots) · High (leaf drop, sunburned fruit)
diseases.symptoms_en: Brown spots on leaves, yellowing, premature leaf drop in humid weather.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya kahawia majani, kuwitikia, majani kuanguka mapema unyevu.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered sprays at first spots. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa zilizoidhinishwa mara madoa yanapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_sw: Kata matawi kwa hewa, usafi wa shamba.
diseases.scanner_notes: Leaf spots + drop pattern; humid season timing.

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Main harvest March–September; export window June–September. The 5-year wait is funded by intercropping the avenues in years 0–3.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Mavuno makuu Machi–Septemba; dirisha la kuuza nje Juni–Septemba. Kusubiri miaka 5 kunafadhiliwa na kupanda mazao katikati miaka 0–3.
market_notes.price_notes_en: Local ~10–50 KES per fruit by size; export-grade Hass several multiples (November 2026). Establishment ~50,000–100,000 KES per acre before full returns.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: Soko la ndani ~10–50 KES kwa tunda; Hass ya kuuza nje mara kadhaa zaidi (Novemba 2026). Uanzishaji ~50,000–100,000 KES kwa eka kabla ya faida kamili.
